150	// Keep keyframes sorted by position
151	function sortKeyframes(keyframes: Keyframe[]): Keyframe[] {
152	  return [...keyframes].sort((a, b) => a.position - b.position)
153	}

155	// Convert native handles to timeline format [leftX, leftY, rightX, rightY]
156	function handlesToSerialized(handles: BezierHandles): [number, number, number, number] {
157	  return [handles.left[0], handles.left[1], handles.right[0], handles.right[1]]
158	}

160	// Convert timeline handles to native format
161	function serializedToHandles(handles: [number, number, number, number]): BezierHandles {
162	  return {
163	    left: [handles[0], handles[1]],
164	    right: [handles[2], handles[3]],
165	    type: 'aligned',
166	  }
167	}

169	// Convert native keyframe to timeline format
170	function keyframeToSerialized(kf: Keyframe, index: number, total: number): TimelineKeyframe {
171	  return {
172	    id: kf.id,
173	    position: kf.position,
174	    connectedRight: index < total - 1 && kf.interpolation !== 'hold',
175	    handles: handlesToSerialized(kf.handles || DEFAULT_BEZIER_HANDLES),
176	    value: kf.value,
177	  }
178	}

180	// Convert timeline keyframe to native format
181	function serializedToKeyframe(tkf: TimelineKeyframe): Keyframe {
182	  return {
183	    id: tkf.id,
184	    position: tkf.position,
185	    value: tkf.value as KeyframeValue,
186	    interpolation: tkf.connectedRight ? 'bezier' : 'hold',
187	    handles: serializedToHandles(tkf.handles),
188	  }
189	}

191	// Detect value type for timeline track data
192	function detectValueType(value: KeyframeValue): string {
193	  if (typeof value === 'number') return 'BasicKeyframedTrack'
194	  if (typeof value === 'boolean') return 'BasicKeyframedTrack'
195	  if (typeof value === 'string') return 'BasicKeyframedTrack'
196	  if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null) {
197	    if ('r' in value && 'g' in value && 'b' in value) return 'BasicKeyframedTrack'
198	  }
199	  return 'BasicKeyframedTrack'
200	}

206	export const useTimelineStore = create<TimelineStore>()(
207	  subscribeWithSelector((set, get) => ({
208	    // === Initial State ===
209	    sequence: { ...DEFAULT_SEQUENCE_STATE },
210	    tracks: new Map(),
211	    markers: [],
212	    position: 0,
213	    playing: false,
214	    loop: true,
215	    loopInOut: false,
216	    playbackSpeed: 1,
217	    selectedKeyframeIds: new Set(),
218	    selectedTrackIds: new Set(),
219	    selectedMarkerId: null,
220	    connectingFromMarkerId: null,
221	
222	    // === Sequence Actions ===
223	    setLength: length => {
224	      set(state => {
225	        const newLength = Math.max(0.1, length)
226	        const { outPoint } = state.sequence
227	
228	        return {
229	          sequence: {
230	            ...state.sequence,
231	            length: newLength,
232	            // If outPoint is set, clamp it; otherwise leave undefined
233	            outPoint: outPoint !== undefined ? Math.min(outPoint, newLength) : undefined,
234	          },
235	          position: Math.min(state.position, newLength),
236	        }
237	      })
238	    },
239	
240	    setFps: fps => {
241	      set(state => ({
242	        sequence: { ...state.sequence, fps: Math.max(1, Math.round(fps)) },
243	      }))
244	    },
245	
246	    // === In/Out Point Actions ===
247	    setInPoint: time => {
248	      set(state => {
249	        const { sequence } = state
250	        const max = sequence.outPoint ?? sequence.length
251	        const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(time, max))
252	        return {
253	          sequence: { ...sequence, inPoint: clamped },
254	        }
255	      })
256	    },
257	
258	    setOutPoint: time => {
259	      set(state => {
260	        const { sequence } = state
261	        const min = sequence.inPoint ?? 0
262	        const clamped = Math.max(min, Math.min(time, sequence.length))
263	        return {
264	          sequence: { ...sequence, outPoint: clamped },
265	        }
266	      })
267	    },
268	
269	    clearInOutPoints: () => {
270	      set(state => ({
271	        sequence: { ...state.sequence, inPoint: undefined, outPoint: undefined },
272	      }))
273	    },
274	
275	    // === Playback Actions ===
276	    setPosition: position => {
277	      const { sequence } = get()
278	      set({ position: Math.max(0, Math.min(position, sequence.length)) })
279	    },
280	
281	    play: () => set({ playing: true }),
282	    pause: () => set({ playing: false }),
283	    togglePlay: () => set(state => ({ playing: !state.playing })),
284	    toggleLoop: () => set(state => ({ loop: !state.loop })),
285	    toggleLoopInOut: () => set(state => ({ loopInOut: !state.loopInOut })),
286	
287	    setPlaybackSpeed: speed => {
288	      set({ playbackSpeed: Math.max(0.1, Math.min(10, speed)) })
289	    },
290	
291	    stepForward: (frames = 1) => {
292	      const { sequence, position } = get()
293	      const frameTime = 1 / sequence.fps
294	      set({ position: Math.min(position + frameTime * frames, sequence.length) })
295	    },
296	
297	    stepBackward: (frames = 1) => {
298	      const { sequence, position } = get()
299	      const frameTime = 1 / sequence.fps
300	      set({ position: Math.max(position - frameTime * frames, 0) })
301	    },
302	
303	    goToStart: () => set({ position: 0 }),
304	    goToEnd: () => set(state => ({ position: state.sequence.length })),
305	
306	    // === Track Actions ===
307	    getOrCreateTrack: (fieldPath, defaultValue) => {
308	      const { tracks } = get()
309	      let track = tracks.get(fieldPath)
310	
311	      if (!track) {
312	        track = {
313	          id: fieldPath, // Use fieldPath as ID for simplicity
314	          fieldPath,
315	          keyframes: [],
316	          defaultValue,
317	        }

328

330	      const tracks = new Map(get().tracks)
331	      tracks.delete(trackId)
332	      // Clean up marker connections for this track
333	      const markers = get().markers.map(m => ({
334	        ...m,
335	        connectedKeyframes: m.connectedKeyframes.filter(c => c.trackId !== trackId),
336	      }))
337	      set({ tracks, markers })

339	
340	    deleteTracksForOperators: operatorIds => {
341	      const tracks = new Map(get().tracks)
342	      let changed = false
343	      for (const [trackId] of tracks) {
344	        for (const opId of operatorIds) {
345	          // opId is like "/my-op" or "/container/child"
346	          // track prefix is "my-op / " or "container / child / "
347	          const prefix = `${opId.slice(1).split('/').join(' / ')} / `
348	          if (trackId.startsWith(prefix)) {
349	            tracks.delete(trackId)
350	            changed = true
351	            break
352	          }
353	        }
354	      }
355	      if (changed) set({ tracks })
356	    },
357	
358	    renameTracksForOperator: (oldOperatorId, newOperatorId, childOperatorIds) => {
359	      // Skip if IDs are the same (idempotent)
360	      if (oldOperatorId === newOperatorId) {
361	        return
362	      }
363	
364	      const before = captureTimelineState()
365	
366	      const tracks = new Map(get().tracks)
367	      const markers = [...get().markers]
368	      const selectedTrackIds = get().selectedTrackIds
369	      let changed = false
370	      let markersChanged = false
371	
372	      // Convert operator ID to object name for matching
373	      // "/my-op" -> "my-op"
374	      // "/container/child" -> "container / child"
375	      const oldObjectName = oldOperatorId.slice(1).split('/').join(' / ')
376	
377	      // Build the prefix to match
378	      const oldPrefix = `${oldObjectName} / `
379	
380	      // If child operator IDs are provided, convert them to object names for checking
381	      const childObjectNames = new Set(
382	        childOperatorIds?.map(id => id.slice(1).split('/').join(' / ')) || []
383	      )
384	
385	      // Track ID mappings for marker and selection updates
386	      const trackIdMap = new Map<string, string>()
387	
388	      // Iterate through all tracks and rename matching ones
389	      for (const [oldTrackId, track] of tracks) {
390	        if (oldTrackId.startsWith(oldPrefix)) {
391	          const oldOpSegments = oldOperatorId.slice(1).split('/')
392	          const trackSegments = oldTrackId.split(' / ')
393	
394	          // Check if the first N segments of the track match our operator path
395	          let isExactMatch = trackSegments.length > oldOpSegments.length
396	          for (let i = 0; i < oldOpSegments.length && isExactMatch; i++) {
397	            if (trackSegments[i] !== oldOpSegments[i]) {
398	              isExactMatch = false
399	            }
400	          }
401	
402	          if (isExactMatch) {
403	            const fieldSegments = trackSegments.slice(oldOpSegments.length)
404	
405	            // Check if this track belongs to a child operator
406	            // If we have child operator IDs, use them for exact matching
407	            let belongsToChild = false
408	            if (childObjectNames.size > 0 && fieldSegments.length >= 2) {
409	              // Check if adding the first field segment would form a child operator
410	              const potentialChildObjectName = [
411	                ...trackSegments.slice(0, oldOpSegments.length + 1),
412	              ].join(' / ')
413	              belongsToChild = childObjectNames.has(potentialChildObjectName)
414	            }
415	
416	            if (!belongsToChild) {
417	              // This track belongs to this specific operator
418	              const newOpSegments = newOperatorId.slice(1).split('/')
419	              const newTrackId = [...newOpSegments, ...fieldSegments].join(' / ')
420	
421	              const renamedTrack: Track = {
422	                ...track,
423	                id: newTrackId,
424	                fieldPath: newTrackId,
425	              }
426	
427	              tracks.set(newTrackId, renamedTrack)
428	              tracks.delete(oldTrackId)
429	              trackIdMap.set(oldTrackId, newTrackId)
430	              changed = true
431	            }
432	          }
433	        }
434	      }
435	
436	      // Update marker connections to reference new track IDs
437	      if (trackIdMap.size > 0) {
438	        for (let i = 0; i < markers.length; i++) {
439	          const marker = markers[i]
440	          const updatedConnections = marker.connectedKeyframes.map(conn => {
441	            const newTrackId = trackIdMap.get(conn.trackId)
442	            return newTrackId ? { ...conn, trackId: newTrackId } : conn
443	          })
444	
445	          if (
446	            updatedConnections.some(
447	              (c, idx) => c.trackId !== marker.connectedKeyframes[idx].trackId
448	            )
449	          ) {
450	            markers[i] = { ...marker, connectedKeyframes: updatedConnections }
451	            markersChanged = true
452	          }
453	        }
454	      }
455	
456	      if (changed) {
457	        // Update selectedTrackIds to use new track IDs
458	        const newSelectedTrackIds = new Set<string>()
459	        for (const oldTrackId of selectedTrackIds) {
460	          const newTrackId = trackIdMap.get(oldTrackId)
461	          if (newTrackId) {
462	            newSelectedTrackIds.add(newTrackId)
463	          } else if (tracks.has(oldTrackId)) {
464	            // Track wasn't renamed, keep the old ID
465	            newSelectedTrackIds.add(oldTrackId)
466	          }
467	          // If track was deleted, don't add to new selection
468	        }
469	
470	        // Only update markers if they actually changed
471	        if (markersChanged) {
472	          set({ tracks, markers, selectedTrackIds: newSelectedTrackIds })
473	        } else {
474	          set({ tracks, selectedTrackIds: newSelectedTrackIds })
475	        }
476	
477	        fireTimelineMutation('Rename operator tracks', before)
478	      }
479	    },

483	      return track ? track.keyframes.length > 0 : false

5	import { isHexColor } from 'validator'
6	
7	import {
8	  BooleanField,

10	  CompoundPropsField,
11	  DateField,
12	  type Field,

14	  NumberField,

30	// Use a type alias to simplify field typing
31	// biome-ignore lint/suspicious/noExplicitAny: Field type requires generic parameter
32	type AnyField = Field<any>

35	// Type Guards
36	// ============================================================================
37	
38	// Check if a field type can be animated
39	export function isAnimatableField(field: AnyField): boolean {
40	  return (
41	    field instanceof NumberField ||
42	    field instanceof BooleanField ||
43	    field instanceof StringField ||
44	    field instanceof StringLiteralField ||
45	    field instanceof ColorField ||
46	    field instanceof DateField ||
47	    field instanceof Vec2Field ||
48	    field instanceof Vec3Field ||
49	    field instanceof Point2DField ||
50	    field instanceof Point3DField ||
51	    field instanceof CompoundPropsField ||
52	    field instanceof ListField
53	  )
54	}

56	// ============================================================================
57	// Type Conversions
58	// ============================================================================
59	
60	// Convert a field value to a keyframe value
61	export function fieldValueToKeyframeValue(
62	  field: AnyField,
63	  // biome-ignore lint/suspicious/noExplicitAny: Field values can be any type
64	  value: any
65	): KeyframeValue {
66	  // Number field - direct passthrough
67	  if (field instanceof NumberField) {
68	    return value as number
69	  }
70	
71	  // Boolean field - direct passthrough
72	  if (field instanceof BooleanField) {
73	    return value as boolean
74	  }
75	
76	  // String fields - direct passthrough
77	  if (field instanceof StringField || field instanceof StringLiteralField) {
78	    return value as string
79	  }
80	
81	  // Color field - hex to RGBA (0-1 range)
82	  if (field instanceof ColorField) {
83	    if (typeof value === 'string' && isHexColor(value)) {
84	      return hexToRgba(value) as RGBA
85	    }
86	    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
87	      return colorToRgba(value) as RGBA
88	    }
89	    return value as RGBA
90	  }
91	
92	  // Date field - Temporal to epoch milliseconds
93	  if (field instanceof DateField) {
94	    if (
95	      value instanceof Temporal.PlainDateTime ||
96	      (value && typeof value.toZonedDateTime === 'function')
97	    ) {
98	      const instant = (value as Temporal.PlainDateTime).toZonedDateTime('UTC').toInstant()
99	      return instant.epochMilliseconds
100	    }
101	    return value as number
102	  }
103	
104	  // Vec2 field - normalize to object format
105	  if (field instanceof Vec2Field) {
106	    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
107	      return { x: value[0], y: value[1] } as Vec2
108	    }
109	    return { x: value.x, y: value.y } as Vec2
110	  }
111	
112	  // Vec3 field - normalize to object format
113	  if (field instanceof Vec3Field) {
114	    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
115	      return { x: value[0], y: value[1], z: value[2] } as Vec3
116	    }
117	    return { x: value.x, y: value.y, z: value.z } as Vec3
118	  }
119	
120	  // Point2D field - normalize to object format
121	  if (field instanceof Point2DField) {
122	    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
123	      return { lng: value[0], lat: value[1] } as Point2D
124	    }
125	    return { lng: value.lng, lat: value.lat } as Point2D
126	  }
127	
128	  // Point3D field - normalize to object format
129	  if (field instanceof Point3DField) {
130	    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
131	      return { lng: value[0], lat: value[1], alt: value[2] } as Point3D
132	    }
133	    return { lng: value.lng, lat: value.lat, alt: value.alt } as Point3D
134	  }
135	
136	  // Compound field - recursive conversion
137	  if (field instanceof CompoundPropsField) {
138	    const result: Record<string, KeyframeValue> = {}
139	    for (const [key, subField] of Object.entries(field.fields)) {
140	      if (value && key in value) {
141	        result[key] = fieldValueToKeyframeValue(subField as AnyField, value[key])
142	      }
143	    }
144	    return result
145	  }
146	
147	  // Default: return as-is
148	  return value

151	// Convert a keyframe value back to a field value
152	export function keyframeValueToFieldValue(
153	  field: AnyField,
154	  kfValue: KeyframeValue
155	  // biome-ignore lint/suspicious/noExplicitAny: Field values can be any type
156	): any {
157	  // Number field - direct passthrough
158	  if (field instanceof NumberField) {
159	    return kfValue as number
160	  }
161	
162	  // Boolean field - direct passthrough
163	  if (field instanceof BooleanField) {
164	    return kfValue as boolean
165	  }
166	
167	  // String fields - direct passthrough
168	  if (field instanceof StringField || field instanceof StringLiteralField) {
169	    return kfValue as string
170	  }

172	  // Color field - RGBA to hex
173	  if (field instanceof ColorField) {
174	    const rgba = kfValue as RGBA
175	    return rgbaToHex(rgba as ColorRGBA)
176	  }
177	
178	  // Date field - epoch milliseconds to Temporal
179	  if (field instanceof DateField) {
180	    const epochMs = Math.round(kfValue as number)
181	    return Temporal.Instant.fromEpochMilliseconds(epochMs)
182	      .toZonedDateTimeISO('UTC')
183	      .toPlainDateTime()
184	  }
185	
186	  // Vec2/Vec3/Point fields - return as object (fields accept both)
187	  if (
188	    field instanceof Vec2Field ||
189	    field instanceof Vec3Field ||
190	    field instanceof Point2DField ||
191	    field instanceof Point3DField
192	  ) {
193	    return kfValue
194	  }
195	
196	  // Compound field - recursive conversion
197	  if (field instanceof CompoundPropsField) {
198	    const kfObj = kfValue as Record<string, KeyframeValue>
199	    const result: Record<string, unknown> = {}
200	    for (const [key, subField] of Object.entries(field.fields)) {
201	      if (key in kfObj) {
202	        result[key] = keyframeValueToFieldValue(subField as AnyField, kfObj[key])
203	      }
204	    }
205	    return result
206	  }
207	
208	  // Default: return as-is
209	  return kfValue

221	// Convert operator ID to Theatre.js object name format
222	// "/my-operator" -> "my-operator", "/container/nested" -> "container / nested"

227	// Build the field path for timeline track
228	// Uses Theatre.js format: "objectName / fieldName / subField"
229	export function getFieldPath(opId: string, fieldName: string, subPath?: string[]): string {
230	  const objectName = opIdToObjectName(opId)

235	// Parse a track ID and return the corresponding operator and field
236	// Returns null if operator/field not found
237	export function getFieldFromTrackPath(fieldPath: string): {
238	  operator: Operator<IOperator>
239	  fieldName: string
240	  subPath?: string[]
241	  field: AnyField
242	} | null {
243	  const parts = fieldPath.split(' / ')
244	  if (parts.length < 2) return null
245	
246	  // Reconstruct operator ID by trying each split point
247	  // "container / nested / fieldName" → try "/container/nested", then "/container"
248	  let operator: Operator<IOperator> | null = null
249	  let opPartCount = 0
250	
251	  for (let i = parts.length - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
252	    const opId = `/${parts.slice(0, i + 1).join('/')}`
253	    operator = getOp(opId)
254	    if (operator) {
255	      opPartCount = i + 1
256	      break
257	    }
258	  }
259	
260	  if (!operator) return null
261	
262	  const fieldName = parts[opPartCount]
263	  const subPath = parts.slice(opPartCount + 1)
264	
265	  // Navigate to the field
266	  let field: AnyField | undefined = operator.inputs[fieldName] as AnyField
267	  if (!field) return null

269	  // For compound fields, navigate to sub-field
270	  if (subPath.length > 0 && field instanceof CompoundPropsField) {
271	    field = field.fields[subPath[0]] as AnyField
272	  }
273	
274	  if (!field) return null

299
